abilities.name: Hearthfire Spark
abilities.description: Snap your fingers to create a small flame on a candle, torch or kindling within arm's reach.
abilities.cost: Fingertips blister if used more than a handful of times an hour

growth.grows: how far the spark reaches and how wet the fuel can be

abilities.name: Runed Ward
abilities.description: Draw a rune on a door with chalk and you hear a chime if anyone opens it before dawn.
abilities.cost: The rune fades at dawn; one rune at a time

growth.grows: how many doors and how long the rune lasts

abilities.name: Beast Tongue
abilities.description: Speak to a horse, dog or bird and understand one simple answer it gives back.
abilities.cost: Only one animal per day remembers you kindly

growth.grows: how clever a beast and how long the talk

abilities.name: Shield Wall Sense
abilities.description: Hold a shield in a line of fighters and you can sense where the next blow will fall on the line.
abilities.cost: Needs at least two allies beside you

growth.grows: how long a line and how many blows ahead

abilities.name: Minor Mending
abilities.description: Touch a broken buckle, strap or blade and it holds together for one more day.
abilities.cost: The mend fails at the worst moment if you lie about the cause

growth.grows: how badly broken and how long it holds

abilities.name: Lay of the Land
abilities.description: Climb to a high point and you can read the terrain for a day's walk, spotting the safest road.
abilities.cost: Needs a clear view and a quarter hour

abilities.name: Glamour Mask
abilities.description: Cast a light glamour so strangers remember your face as plainer than it is, until you speak your name.
abilities.cost: Itchy skin; magic users see through it

growth.grows: how many people it fools and how sharp-eyed

abilities.name: Healing Poultice
abilities.description: Brew herbs into a poultice that halves the time a wound takes to close.
abilities.cost: Needs fresh herbs and an hour of brewing

growth.grows: how serious a wound it helps

abilities.name: Dragonblood Courage
abilities.description: Shout a battle cry and allies who hear it stand their ground against fear until the fight's next lull.
abilities.cost: Voice gives out after the third cry

growth.grows: how many allies and how great a terror

abilities.name: Arcane Sight
abilities.description: Squint at an object to see a faint glow if it has been enchanted, and its color hints at the kind.
abilities.cost: Eyes water and blur for a minute

growth.grows: how faint an enchantment and how much it tells

abilities.name: Tavern Tale
abilities.description: Tell a story in a tavern and by the end you can steer the room's mood toward cheer or anger.

growth.grows: how big a crowd and how strong the mood

abilities.name: Wardstone Pocket
abilities.description: Hold a charged stone and it turns aside one curse or spell aimed at you, then cracks.
abilities.cost: The stone must be recharged under a full moon

growth.grows: how strong a spell it turns aside
